---
title: theme-minimal
subtitle: "Minimal theme: white panel, light grey gridlines, no axis lines."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Equivalent to ggplot2's `theme_minimal()`. For the gribouille default
(grey panel with white gridlines) use [`theme-grey`](theme-grey.qmd).

## Usage

```typst
theme-minimal()
```



## Returns

Theme dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/theme-minimal-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme-minimal(),
)
```

## See also

[`theme-grey`](theme-grey.qmd), [`theme-classic`](theme-classic.qmd), [`theme-void`](theme-void.qmd), [`theme`](theme.qmd).
